790590101.text: This is a cut scene from the show "Journey to the East"

790590102.text: The original idea revolved around a tale of a traveler and their journey eastwards from Fontaine to Sumeru City to search for unassuming wisdom in the House of Daena.

790590103.text: This scene concerned how the traveler saved the "Master of Earthly Transformations" from being crushed by a massive boulder, and their adventures on the road.

790590104.text: Unfortunately, the Hydro Eidolons acting the part of both the traveler as well as the Master of Earthly Transformations have disappeared.

790590105.text: If only someone could <color=#00E1FFFF>bring them both back</color>, and capture the rehearsal by the huge boulder...
